about: Images of this lane beside mcp-surface-corpus's own (its images.json), pinned by the digest of the multi-platform index. None now: the Rust toolchain (rust-build, rust:1.99.1-bookworm, recorded 25 Nov 2026) became the sandbox's own image key at mcp-surface-corpus 4504c0b (same digest), and loadImages refuses a key of ours that the sandbox also names. A new image of ours goes here only by a reviewed commit.
